$comment: Environment variables subscan reads. Names and metadata only - never put values here. Used by scripts/vercel-env.mjs (npm run env:status / env:sync / env:add). Add new variables here and run `npm run env:sync`.

variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.help: Google Gemini API key for the agent. Create one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

variables.name: AUTOPILOT_SEAL_KEY
variables.help: 32-byte secret (64 hex characters) that seals Autopilot's per-user agent keys. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it invalidates existing Autopilot access (users grant again).

variables.name: TEXTILE_API_KEY
variables.help: Textile FX partner key (self-serve: app.textilecredit.com → profile → API keys). Needed for Autopilot to convert currencies from a passkey wallet (keyless quotes need the payer's own signature). Also embeds subscan's builder codes in Textile's swap transaction.

variables.name: TEXTILE_API_BASE
variables.help: Override the Textile FX API base URL (default https://api.textilecredit.com/v2).

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.help: Public URL used in the ERC-8004 agent card. Preview deployments fall back to their own URL.

variables.name: ERC8004_AGENT_ID
variables.help: ERC-8004 agent id from the Identity Registry on Celo (from the Wallet page or `npm run agent:register`).

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CELO_ATTRIBUTION_CODE
variables.help: Overrides the built-in hackathon attribution code (celo_e97672462153). Leave unset unless it changes.

variables.name: AGENT_OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.help: Only for `npm run agent:register` on your own machine. Never stored on Vercel.
